root.label: Education Department reveals blocked fraudulent student aid

events.label: Education Department reveals blocked fraudulent student aid

slots.name: blocked aid
slots.sentence: The size of the scam became clear last year when the Education Department revealed it blocked more than $1 billion in fraudulent student aid and identified nearly $90 million that had already been fraudulently disbursed.

slots.name: deceased recipients
slots.sentence: More than $30 million went to deceased individuals, while more than $40 million went to companies using bots disguised as fake students.
